# Chronic Insomnia Authorization Guide
Subtitle: Decision Support
Specialty: Sleep Medicine
Logo: /manus-storage/chronic-insomnia-compass-logo_416500fd.png
Appeal Letter route: /sleep/chronic-insomnia/appeal-letter

## CPT Codes — Insomnia Evaluation & Management

| CPT Code | Description | Auth Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 99213–99215 | Office visit — E&M (sleep specialist) | Rarely | Document ISI score, sleep diary, CBT-I history |
| 95810 | Polysomnography — to rule out OSA or PLMD | Often | Required when comorbid sleep disorder suspected |
| 90837 | Psychotherapy, 60 min (CBT-I) | Sometimes | Prior auth for behavioral health benefits |
| 90834 | Psychotherapy, 45 min (CBT-I) | Sometimes | Most common CBT-I billing code |
| H0004 | Behavioral health counseling (CBT-I) | Sometimes | Used by some payers for CBT-I |
| 99406–99407 | Smoking cessation counseling | Rarely | If tobacco use contributing to insomnia |

## ICD-10-CM Diagnosis Codes

| ICD-10 | Description | Use When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| G47.00 | Insomnia, unspecified | Pending full characterization |
| G47.01 | Insomnia due to medical condition | Comorbid pain, GERD, nocturia driving insomnia |
| G47.09 | Other insomnia | Chronic insomnia disorder (ICSD-3); most commonly used |
| F51.01 | Primary insomnia | Idiopathic insomnia without identifiable cause |
| F51.05 | Insomnia due to other mental disorder | Insomnia driven by depression, anxiety, PTSD |
| F51.09 | Other insomnia not due to a substance or known physiological condition | Psychophysiological insomnia |

## Medication Prior Authorization Requirements

### Suvorexant (Belsomra)
- Chronic insomnia diagnosis (≥3 months, ≥3 nights/week)
- ISI score ≥15 or equivalent documentation
- Step therapy: Z-drug or benzodiazepine trial often required
- CBT-I documentation or contraindication note

Common denial reason: Step therapy not met, formulary tier restrictions

### Lemborexant (Dayvigo)
- Chronic insomnia diagnosis with objective severity documentation
- Step therapy: Prior Z-drug or suvorexant trial
- CBT-I documentation or contraindication note

Common denial reason: Step therapy not met, non-formulary

### Low-dose Doxepin (Silenor 3–6 mg)
- Sleep maintenance insomnia (early morning awakening)
- Step therapy: Z-drug trial often required
- Distinguish from antidepressant doxepin (different dosing)

Common denial reason: Confused with antidepressant indication, step therapy

### Eszopiclone (Lunesta) / Zolpidem (Ambien)
- Chronic insomnia diagnosis
- Often first-line per payer formulary
- Quantity limits: typically 30 tablets/30 days

Common denial reason: Quantity limit exceeded, long-term use concerns

## Documentation Checklist
- ISI (Insomnia Severity Index) score ≥15 documented in clinic note
- Duration ≥3 months, frequency ≥3 nights/week (ICSD-3 chronic insomnia criteria)
- Daytime impairment documented (fatigue, concentration, mood, occupational/social function)
- Sleep diary (2-week minimum) showing sleep onset latency or WASO ≥30 minutes
- CBT-I trial documentation: provider, dates, number of sessions, response
- PSG results if comorbid OSA or PLMD suspected
- Prior pharmacologic trials with dates, doses, and reasons for discontinuation
- Contraindications to avoided agents (e.g., fall risk for benzodiazepines in elderly)

## References
1. Sateia MJ, et al. "Clinical Practice Guideline for the Pharmacologic Treatment of Chronic Insomnia in Adults." J Clin Sleep Med. 2017;13(2):307–349.
2. Edinger JD, et al. "Behavioral and Psychological Treatments for Chronic Insomnia Disorder in Adults: An AASM Clinical Practice Guideline." J Clin Sleep Med. 2021;17(2):255–262.
3. AASM April 2026 CPG: Combination CBT-I + Pharmacotherapy for Chronic Insomnia. J Clin Sleep Med. 2026.
4. ICSD-3. American Academy of Sleep Medicine. 2014.
5. AASM Practice Guidelines: https://aasm.org/clinical-resources/practice-standards/practice-guidelines/
